messages:
Maria: Heads up — running an overnight warmup for demo fleet in uk-west. Need to confirm standby vs spot mix for 06:00-10:00 UTC tomorrow. Anyone able to lock a small standby slice (~4 A100) or should we rely on spot fallback? @Devon
Devon: I can try to carve out 4 standby from reserve but need to check quota. Giving me 10m.
vendor-bot: Vendor status: uk-west available: 12 A100 on reserved, spot price stable. ETA for additional racks 7d. https://vendor.status/uk-west :information_source:
Sam: If quota's tight, we can do hybrid: 2 standby + 2 spot with preemptible fallback. Slight perf variance but safe for demo.
Maria: Prefer 0 preemptions during demo. Can we mark those two as 'burst' standby? Is that a thing?
Devon: We have a burst pool but needs finance approval for extra charge. @Leo can you sign off? cc @VendorOps
Leo: On it — what's the estimated cost delta? ballpark
Devon: Rough calc: +$420/day for two burst A100s overnight window. I'll paste terraform snippet to reserve if approved.
Devon: ```
resource "redwood_pool" "demo_overnight" {
  region = "uk-west"
  gpu = "A100"
  count = 2
  mode = "burst"
  window = "06:00-10:00"
}
```
VendorOps: Can confirm we can map burst to dedicated racks for the window. Need final OK by 18:00 UTC today to lock.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate ops checklist. @Devon please hold the terraform PR but don't merge until Leo approves.
Leo: Approving now. Go ahead with PR and cost tag. :money_with_wings:
Devon: PR opened: https://redwood/repo/pull/4321 — please tag finance and set label `overnight-demo`
ops-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: warmup run at 05:30 UTC; will run smoke tests and upload telemetry to /s3/demo-warmup/uk-west/1890043210
Maria: Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll post short postmortem if anything weird shows up. :eyes:
Sam: Quick note — enable KV cache priming for these runs, adds ~30s but reduces initial jitter.
Maria: Good call, Sam. Devon set cache=true in PR?
Devon: Already added, see PR diff. Also tagging @VendorOps for kernel selection flags.
